activity.notes: Smithsonian archival notes quote the 1874 Indian agent report that Irataba had been chief for about twenty years, supporting an approximate start around 1854. He is independently identified in federal records as Chief of the Mohaves in 1864 and 1872. ATLAS therefore uses c.1854–1874 rather than inventing an exact accession date.

sources.citation_text: Smithsonian archival notes identify Irataba as chief of the Mohaves in 1864 and quote the 1874 Indian agent report that his death ended about twenty years as chief.
